title: Spun Around the Ring
statement:
Two words are written around circular rings. Word `b` is a spin of word `a` if you can cut `a` at some point and swap the two pieces to get exactly `b`. For example, `cdeab` is a spin of `abcde`. A word counts as a spin of itself (cut at the very start).

## Input
The first line contains `a`. The second line contains `b`.

## Output
Print `YES` if `b` is a spin of `a`, otherwise print `NO`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |a|, |b| <= 95000`
- Both words contain only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
